job.name: ig22_host
job.meaning: ведущий вечернего ток-шоу ~45, тёмные волнистые волосы с проседью, серый пиджак, голубая рубашка, за столом, ночной город
job.style: Photorealistic cinematic photo, like a real frame from a TV talk show camera. Look: a real frame from a high-end camera, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, NOT CGI, NOT a glamour retouch. No text, no logos, no watermark.
job.style_qa: фотореализм, ведущий ток-шоу за столом, ночной город за окном, без текста; взгляд чуть в сторону (на гостя) — задумано
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary man (not a celebrity, not a model), looks genuinely real.
job.prompt: Vertical 9:16. A charismatic Russian late-night talk show host about 45 with dark wavy hair greying at the temples, light stubble, a charcoal grey blazer over a light blue open-collar shirt, sitting behind a glossy wooden host desk with a coffee mug, turned slightly to his right as if listening to a guest, looking just past the camera, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, curious friendly expression, one hand resting on the desk. Medium shot from the waist up, face large and sharp, top of head about 12% below the upper edge. Background: a late-night show studio set with large windows onto a night city skyline with lit skyscrapers, warm practical lamps and bookshelves, softly blurred.
